title: EvaluationResult
description: Response body for POST /session/{session_id}/submit – returns AI-generated feedback and score.

score.description: Numeric score awarded to the submission (0–100).

feedback.description: Detailed AI-generated feedback for the student.
feedback.example: Good iterative approach. Consider handling edge cases where the array is empty.

follow_up_question.description: Optional follow-up question generated by the AI to probe deeper understanding.
follow_up_question.example: What is the time complexity of your solution?

evaluated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the evaluation was completed.
